newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia signs telecom deal with Alcatel.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia signs telecom deal with Alcatel.

text.p: Tunisia on Tuesday signed a contract with France's Alcatel for global standard mobile (GSM) mobile phones, telecommunciations officials said.
The contract was signed for Tunisia by the state-run Office National des Telecommunications called "Tunisie Telecom" at a ceremony chaired by the Tunisian Communications Minister Ahmed Friaa.
Under project, a 30,000 subscriber network will cover Tunisia's main urban, industrial and tourist areas from the northern region of Bizerte to the southern island of Jerba.
The system is planned to be operational by the first quarter of 1998.
The value of the contract was not disclosed.
